template_data.headline_html: Five certs. What each one actually does.

items.title: 8(a) Business Development
items.sub: 9 years of set-aside access, sole-source awards, and SBA mentoring — deepest entry ramp available.

items.title: WOSB / EDWOSB
items.sub: Compete in 800+ NAICS codes restricted to women-owned firms. EDWOSB adds disadvantaged-business preference.

items.title: SDVOSB
items.sub: VA set-asides and DoD preferences — one of the fastest-growing segments in the federal market.

items.title: HUBZone
items.sub: Price evaluation preferences when your office and 35% of staff are in qualifying zones.

items.title: Mentor-Protégé Program
items.sub: SBA-approved joint ventures with primes — pursue contracts too large to win alone.
